```python
pl.scan_parquet("s3://bucket/%25")
```


### Log output

_No response_

### Issue description

This is not reproducible locally even with FORCE_ASYNC - it only happens when scanning from a real bucket

### Expected behavior

Scan works

### Installed versions

1.2.1
